plugin.name: Gmail
plugin.description: Official Google Gmail remote MCP (Developer Preview): read mail, create drafts, label. No send.

starterPrompts.text: 받은편지함에서 이번 주에 온 메일을 찾아서 요약해 줘요.
방금 이야기한 내용으로 팀에 보낼 메일 초안을 만들어 줘요. 보내기는 제가 직접 할게요.
내 Gmail 라벨 목록을 보여 줘요.

tools.name: gmail.create_draft
tools.description: 메일 초안을 만듭니다. 보내지는 않아요. 보내기는 Gmail에서 직접 해요.

bcc.description: Optional. The blind carbon copy recipients of the email draft. Each string MUST be a valid plain email address (e.g., "user@example.com").

body.description: Optional. The plain text body content of the email draft. Do NOT format this field with Markdown (such as headers `#`, bold `**`, bullet points `*`, or tables `|`). If formatted rich text is desired, use `html_body` instead. If `html_body` is also provided, this field is treated as the plain-text al

cc.description: Optional. The carbon copy recipients of the email draft. Each string MUST be a valid plain email address (e.g., "user@example.com").

htmlBody.description: Optional. The HTML content of the email draft. If provided, this will be used as the rich-text version of the email. Use this field (with valid HTML tags such as ` `, `

includeSignature.description: Optional. Whether to append the user's configured Gmail web signature to the draft. Defaults to false.

replyToMessageId.description: Optional. The ID of the message to reply to. If provided, this will be used as the reply-to message ID for the email draft, and the `body` and `html_body` will be appended to the original message body.

subject.description: Optional. The subject line of the email. Defaults to empty if not provided.

to.description: Optional. The primary recipients of the email draft. Each string MUST be a valid plain email address (e.g., "user@example.com").

autoCreateParentLabels.description: Optional. Whether to automatically create parent labels for nested labels (separated by `/`). Defaults to `true`. When set to `true`, missing parent labels in the hierarchy (e.g., `Projects` and `Projects/Alpha` for `Projects/Alpha/Sprint-1`) are created automatically. When set to `false`, parent la

colorPreset.description: Optional. The color preset tile to assign to the new label. Select from predefined contrast-safe color options (e.g., LABEL_COLOR_PRESET_RED, LABEL_COLOR_PRESET_BLUE, LABEL_COLOR_PRESET_BLACK, LABEL_COLOR_PRESET_GREEN). If omitted, default label styling is applied.

displayName.description: Required. The display name of the label to create. Supports nested label hierarchy using `/` (e.g., `Projects/Alpha/Sprint-1`).

labelListVisibility.description: Optional. The visibility of the label in the label list in the Gmail web interface. Defaults to `LABEL_SHOW`.

messageListVisibility.description: Optional. The visibility of messages with this label in the message list in the Gmail web interface. Defaults to `SHOW`.

labelIds.description: Required. The unique identifiers of the labels to add. Can be a system label ID (e.g., `INBOX`, `STARRED`, `UNREAD`, `IMPORTANT`) or a user-defined label ID. threadId.description: Required. The unique identifier of the thread to add labels to.

labelIds.description: Required. The unique identifiers of the labels to remove. Can be a system label ID (e.g., `INBOX`, `TRASH`, `SPAM`, `STARRED`, `UNREAD`, `IMPORTANT`) or a user-defined label ID. messageId.description: Required. The ID of the message to add the labels to.

tools.description: 메일 한 통의 라벨을 한 번에 바꿉니다.

addLabelIds.description: Optional. The IDs of the labels to add. Can be a system label ID (e.g., `INBOX`, `STARRED`, `UNREAD`, `IMPORTANT`) or a user-defined label ID.

messageId.description: Required. The ID of the message to modify labels for.

removeLabelIds.description: Optional. The IDs of the labels to remove. Can be a system label ID or a user-defined label ID.
